notes: All requests sanitized per fixtures/README.md. cleanup ownership: 'implementer' = the T01 implementer owns deleting the resource; 'upstream-runtime' = resource lives in the throwaway sqlite data dir deleted with the probe instance; 'none' = nothing persisted.

cases.description: Token granted connection alpha only; action call targeting beta via x-oo-connector-alias is denied 403 connection_not_allowed before credential use.
cases.setup: PUT /api/connections/dune alias alpha + beta (api_key, fabricated keys; dune has no credentialValidators); POST /api/runtime-tokens allowedConnections=[alpha stable id].
cases.request: POST /v1/actions/dune.get_execution_status, Authorization: Bearer oct_<redacted>, x-oo-connector-alias: beta, body {"input":{"executionId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"}}
cases.expected: HTTP 403 {success:false, errorCode:'connection_not_allowed', meta:{executionId, actionId, auditPersisted:true}}; no provider call.
cases.cleanup ownership: upstream-runtime (connections + token live in throwaway sqlite; also explicitly revoked/deleted by implementer)

cases.description: Upstream empty-grant asymmetry: allowedConnections=[] and allowedActions=[] mean ALLOW-ALL; allowedProxies=[] means DENY-ALL. Call to beta passes the grant layer and reaches the provider (fails on the fabricated key), proving local NewGrant must reject empty grants.
cases.request: POST /v1/actions/dune.get_execution_status, open token, x-oo-connector-alias: beta, same body as cross_connection.
cases.expected: NOT connection_not_allowed; here HTTP 403 authorization_failed 'invalid API Key' from the provider — the grant layer allowed the call.

cases.description: Omitted alias resolves to connectionName 'default' only; no fallback to other named connections; unknown alias → 404 connection_not_found.
cases.setup: arxiv needs nothing (no_auth virtual default). accuweather has ONLY alias 'primary' (api_key fabricated).
cases.request: POST /v1/actions/arxiv.get_paper without alias header; POST /v1/actions/accuweather.get_current_conditions without alias header; same action with x-oo-connector-alias: ghost.
cases.expected: arxiv 200 via arxiv:default; accuweather default-alias call does NOT use 'primary' (403 configure-credentials / 404 for ghost).

cases.description: no_auth providers synthesize virtual connections (id service:alias) exempt from token connection grants: an alpha-restricted token executes arxiv actions.
cases.expected: HTTP 200 success; virtual arxiv:default bypasses the connection grant.
cases.cleanup ownership: none (nothing persisted; virtual connection synthesized on demand)

cases.description: Runtime-scope stored token cannot access the admin surface (/api/*): 401 unauthorized. Control on a second no-auth instance: admin surface fully open (deployment hazard for T16).
cases.setup: Instance A with OOMOL_CONNECT_ADMIN_TOKEN + stored tokens; instance B with no auth env.
cases.request: GET /api/runtime-tokens with oct_ bearer; with invalid bearer; with no bearer on instance B.
cases.expected: 401 {error:{code:'unauthorized'}} on instance A; 200 [] on instance B.
cases.cleanup ownership: implementer (instance B process killed; both throwaway data dirs removed)

cases.description: Stored token with allowedProxies=[] denies every provider proxy: 403 proxy_not_allowed before egress.
cases.setup: Open token with allowedProxies=[] (empty = deny-all for proxies).
cases.expected: HTTP 403 {errorCode:'proxy_not_allowed', message:'arxiv proxy is not granted to this runtime token.'}.

cases.description: Correlation is exclusively server-side state: initiation mints single-use state (15min TTL); callback carries state+code only; unknown state 400 invalid_oauth_state; real state + fake code transitions the connection request to failed. Happy path (real provider code) blocked-env, not fabricated.
cases.setup: PUT /api/oauth/configs/github with fabricated clientId/clientSecret (env: ALLOWED_CUSTOM_OAUTH=github + ENCRYPTION_KEY).
cases.request: POST /api/oauth/authorizations {service:github}; GET /oauth/callback?state=<unknown>&code=fake; POST /v1/connections/github/connect; GET /v1/connection-requests/:id; GET /oauth/callback?state=<real stateHandle>&code=fake; poll again.
cases.expected: {authorizationUrl,state}; 400 invalid_oauth_state; {authorizationUrl,stateHandle,connectionRequestId,status:'initiated',expiresAt(+10min)}; poll initiated→failed(provider_error) after the correlated callback.
cases.cleanup ownership: upstream-runtime (stored client config + pending request live in throwaway sqlite; config deleted by implementer)

cases.description: Identical POST /v1/actions/{id} repeated with the same Idempotency-Key within 24h replays the original response (same meta.executionId) without re-executing.
cases.setup: Open token; arxiv.get_paper input {id:2301.00001}; key oc-t01-replay2-*.
cases.request: Two sequential POSTs with identical key/action/input/connection.

cases.description: Same Idempotency-Key with a different input → 409 idempotency_key_conflict; includes the cross-token reuse variant proven by the upstream test.
cases.request: POST arxiv.get_paper input {id:2301.00002} with the same key.
cases.expected: HTTP 409 {errorCode:'idempotency_key_conflict', message:'Idempotency-Key has already been used with a different request.'}.

cases.description: Concurrent duplicate with the same key: exactly one request dispatches; the loser gets 409 idempotency_request_in_progress.
cases.expected: One 409 idempotency_request_in_progress (captured live); deterministic corroboration from upstream test 'does not dispatch concurrent requests with the same idempotency key twice'.

cases.description: 24h fixed window edge: after expiry the same key re-executes instead of replaying.
cases.setup: Upstream vitest at the pinned SHA with a supplied clock (method per coordinator ruling 5; no shared-instance clock mutation).
cases.request: npx vitest run src/server/actions/action-idempotency.test.ts --reporter=verbose (test 'expires records 24 hours after the supplied time').

cases.description: meta.auditPersisted=false when run-audit persistence (runs.add) throws; the action result is still returned unchanged.
cases.setup: Upstream vitest at the pinned SHA injecting a failing runs store (no env/config trigger exists; coordinator ruling 6).
cases.request: npx vitest run src/server/actions/action-runner.test.ts -t 'audit storage fails' --reporter=verbose.
cases.expected: Test passes; auditPersisted=false only on runs.add throw (action-runner.ts:174-181).
